raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 1, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that both Ronald Reagan and George H. W. Bush were Vice President (claiming Reagan was VP 1981–1989). Reagan was never Vice President—he was President (1981–1989). The shared office they both held was President of the United States.
